correction_target: A merely imaginable future misuse or a generic safety/quality enhancement is not a PATCH unless the source has a concrete current-task omission, contradiction, or usability failure.
If an equivalent evidence boundary already exists, restating or moving it is not a defect repair.
Final gate must reject unrelated directive/header drift even when decision classification is correct.
